description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Necrotic Ooze undying until end of turn.
If Necrotic Ooze has any +1/+1 counters, activate it using Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Necrotic Ooze, adding {B}.
Necrotic Ooze dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure token, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Fain's fourth ability by paying {3}{B}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 6.
You may also use the infinite Inkling tokens to use Fain's first ability for infinite +1/+1 counters.
